versos.grego: Διώκετε τὴν ἀγάπην, ζηλοῦτε δὲ τὰ πνευματικά, μᾶλλον δὲ ἵνα προφητεύητε.

controles.web: Follow after love, and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
controles.kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
controles.livre: Segui o amor, e desejai com zelo pelos dons espirituais; porém principalmente que profetizeis.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις λαλεῖ ἀλλὰ Θεῷ· οὐδεὶς γὰρ ἀκούει, πνεύματι δὲ λαλεῖ μυστήρια·

controles.web: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God; for no one understands; but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.
controles.kjv: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
controles.livre: Porque o que fala língua estranha ,não fala aos seres humanos, mas sim a Deus; porque ninguém o entende, mas em espírito fala mistérios.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ προφητεύων ἀνθρώποις λαλεῖ οἰκοδομὴν καὶ παράκλησιν καὶ παραμυθίαν.

controles.web: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.
controles.kjv: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
controles.livre: Mas o que profetiza, fala aos seres humanos para edificação, convencimento, e consolação.

versos.grego: ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ ἑαυτὸν οἰκοδομεῖ· ὁ δὲ προφητεύων ἐκκλησίαν οἰκοδομεῖ.

controles.web: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
controles.kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
controles.livre: O que fala língua estranha edifica a si mesmo; mas o que profetiza edifica à igreja.

versos.grego: θέλω δὲ πάντας ὑμᾶς λαλεῖν γλώσσαις, μᾶλλον δὲ ἵνα προφητεύητε· μείζων δὲ ὁ προφητεύων ἢ ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσαις, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ διερμηνεύῃ, ἵνα ἡ ἐκκλησία οἰκοδομὴν λάβῃ.

controles.web: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but rather that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.
controles.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
controles.livre: E eu quero que todos vós faleis línguas, porém mais ainda que profetizeis; porque o que profetiza é maior que o que fala línguas, a não ser que também interprete, para que a igreja receba edificação.

versos.grego: νῦν δέ, ἀδελφοί, ἐὰν ἔλθω πρὸς ὑμᾶς γλώσσαις λαλῶν, τί ὑμᾶς ὠφελήσω, ἐὰν μὴ ὑμῖν λαλήσω ἢ ἐν ἀποκαλύψει ἢ ἐν γνώσει ἢ ἐν προφητείᾳ ἢ διδαχῇ;

controles.web: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you, unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
controles.kjv: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
controles.livre: E agora irmãos, se eu viesse até vos falando línguas, o que vos aproveitaria, se não vos falasse ou por revelação, ou por conhecimento, ou por profecia, ou por doutrina?

versos.grego: ὅμως τὰ ἄψυχα φωνὴν διδόντα, εἴτε αὐλὸς εἴτε κιθάρα, ἐὰν διαστολὴν τοῖς φθόγγοις μὴ δῷ, πῶς γνωσθήσεται τὸ αὐλούμενον ἢ τὸ κιθαριζόμενον;

controles.web: Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
controles.kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
controles.livre: E até as coisas inanimadas, que produzem som, seja flauta, seja harpa, se não derem distinção de sons, como saberá o que se toca com a flauta, ou com a harpa?

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ἐὰν ἄδηλον σάλπιγξ φωνὴν δῷ, τίς παρασκευάσεται εἰς πόλεμον;

controles.web: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?
controles.kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
controles.livre: Porque também se a trombeta der som incerto, quem se preparará para a guerra?

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς διὰ τῆς γλώσσης ἐὰν μὴ εὔσημον λόγον δῶτε, πῶς γνωσθήσεται τὸ λαλούμενον; ἔσεσθε γὰρ εἰς ἀέρα λαλοῦντες.

controles.web: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.
controles.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
controles.livre: Assim mesmo também vós, se com a língua não derdes palavra compreensível, como se entenderá o que se diz? Porque estareis falando para o ar.

versos.grego: τοσαῦτα εἰ τύχοι γένη φωνῶν εἰσιν ἐν κόσμῳ, καὶ οὐδὲν ἄφωνον·

controles.web: There are, it may be, so many kinds of sounds in the world, and none of them is without meaning.
controles.kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
controles.livre: Por exemplo, há tantos tipos de vozes no mundo, e nenhuma delas é muda.

versos.grego: ἐὰν οὖν μὴ εἰδῶ τὴν δύναμιν τῆς φωνῆς, ἔσομαι τῷ λαλοῦντι βάρβαρος καὶ ὁ λαλῶν ἐν ἐμοὶ βάρβαρος.

controles.web: If then I don’t know the meaning of the sound, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.
controles.kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
controles.livre: Portanto, se eu não souber o propósito da voz, serei estrangeiro para o que fala, e o que fala será estrangeiro para mim.

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς, ἐπεὶ ζηλωταί ἐστε πνευμάτων, πρὸς τὴν οἰκοδομὴν τῆς ἐκκλησίας ζητεῖτε ἵνα περισσεύητε.

controles.web: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
controles.kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
controles.livre: Assim também vós, dado que desejais os dons espirituais, procurai neles abundar, para edificação da igreja.

versos.grego: Διὸ ὁ λαλῶν γλώσσῃ προσευχέσθω ἵνα διερμηνεύῃ.

controles.web: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.
controles.kjv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
controles.livre: Portanto, o que fala em língua estranha ,ore para que possa interpretar.

versos.grego: ἐὰν γὰρ προσεύχωμαι γλώσσῃ, τὸ πνεῦμά μου προσεύχεται, ὁ δὲ νοῦς μου ἄκαρπός ἐστιν.

controles.web: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
controles.kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
controles.livre: Porque se eu orar em língua estranha ,meu espírito ora, mas meu entendimento fica sem fruto.

versos.grego: τί οὖν ἐστιν; προσεύξομαι τῷ πνεύματι, προσεύξομαι δὲ καὶ τῷ νοΐ· ψαλῶ τῷ πνεύματι, ψαλῶ δὲ καὶ τῷ νοΐ.

controles.web: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
controles.kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
controles.livre: Então é o que? Orarei com o espírito, mas também orarei com o entendimento; cantarei com o espírito, mas também cantarei com o entendimento.

versos.grego: ἐπεὶ ἐὰν εὐλογῇς πνεύματι, ὁ ἀναπληρῶν τὸν τόπον τοῦ ἰδιώτου πῶς ἐρεῖ τὸ Ἀμήν ἐπὶ τῇ σῇ εὐχαριστίᾳ; ἐπειδὴ τί λέγεις οὐκ οἶδεν·

controles.web: Otherwise if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?
controles.kjv: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
controles.livre: De outra maneira, se tu bendisseres com o espírito, como aquele que não tem conhecimento dirá amém por teu bendizer? Pois ele não sabe o que tu dizes.

versos.grego: σὺ μὲν γὰρ καλῶς εὐχαριστεῖς, ἀλλ’ ὁ ἕτερος οὐκ οἰκοδομεῖται.

controles.web: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.
controles.kjv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
controles.livre: Porque em verdade tu bem dás graças; mas o outro não é edificado.

versos.grego: εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ, πάντων ὑμῶν μᾶλλον γλώσσαις λαλῶ·

controles.web: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.
controles.kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
controles.livre: Graças dou a meu Deus, que mais línguas falo que todos vós.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ θέλω πέντε λόγους τῷ νοΐ μου λαλῆσαι, ἵνα καὶ ἄλλους κατηχήσω, ἢ μυρίους λόγους ἐν γλώσσῃ.

controles.web: However in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.
controles.kjv: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
controles.livre: Porém eu quero mais falar na igreja cinco palavras com meu entendimento, para que eu também possa instruir aos outros, do que dez mil palavras em língua estranha .

versos.grego: Ἀδελφοί, μὴ παιδία γίνεσθε ταῖς φρεσίν, ἀλλὰ τῇ κακίᾳ νηπιάζετε, ταῖς δὲ φρεσὶν τέλειοι γίνεσθε.

controles.web: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
controles.kjv: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
controles.livre: Irmãos, não sejais meninos no entendimento, mas sede meninos na malícia, e adultos no entendimento.

versos.grego: ἐν τῷ νόμῳ γέγραπται ὅτι Ἐν ἑτερογλώσσοις καὶ ἐν χείλεσιν ἑτέρων λαλήσω τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ, καὶ οὐδ’ οὕτως εἰσακούσονταί μου, λέγει Κύριος.

controles.web: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. Not even thus will they hear me, says the Lord.”
controles.kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: Na Lei está escrito: A este povo falarei por gente de outras línguas, e por outros lábios; e ainda assim não me ouvirão, diz o Senhor.

versos.grego: ὥστε αἱ γλῶσσαι εἰς σημεῖόν εἰσιν οὐ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἀλλὰ τοῖς ἀπίστοις, ἡ δὲ προφητεία οὐ τοῖς ἀπίστοις ἀλλὰ τοῖς πιστεύουσιν.

controles.web: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.
controles.kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
controles.livre: Então as línguas estranhas são por sinal, não para os que creem, mas para os que não creem; e a profecia não é para os que não creem, mas para os que creem.

versos.grego: Ἐὰν οὖν συνέλθῃ ἡ ἐκκλησία ὅλη ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ καὶ πάντες λαλῶσιν γλώσσαις, εἰσέλθωσιν δὲ ἰδιῶται ἢ ἄπιστοι, οὐκ ἐροῦσιν ὅτι μαίνεσθε;

controles.web: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?
controles.kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
controles.livre: Pois se toda a igreja se reunir, e todos falarem línguas estranhas , e entrarem alguns sem entendimento ou descrentes, não dirão que estais loucos?

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ πάντες προφητεύωσιν, εἰσέλθῃ δέ τις ἄπιστος ἢ ἰδιώτης, ἐλέγχεται ὑπὸ πάντων, ἀνακρίνεται ὑπὸ πάντων,

controles.web: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.
controles.kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
controles.livre: Mas se todos profetizarem, e algum sem entendimento ou descrente entrar, por todos é convencido, e por todos é julgado.

versos.grego: τὰ κρυπτὰ τῆς καρδίας αὐτοῦ φανερὰ γίνεται, καὶ οὕτως πεσὼν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον προσκυνήσει τῷ Θεῷ, ἀπαγγέλλων ὅτι Ὄντως ὁ Θεὸς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐστιν.

controles.web: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
controles.kjv: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
controles.livre: E assim os segredos de seu coração ficam manifestos, e assim, lançando-se sobre seu rosto, adorará a Deus, reconhecendo publicamente que Deus está entre vós.

versos.grego: Τί οὖν ἐστιν, ἀδελφοί; ὅταν συνέρχησθε, ἕκαστος ψαλμὸν ἔχει, διδαχὴν ἔχει, ἀποκάλυψιν ἔχει, γλῶσσαν ἔχει, ἑρμηνείαν ἔχει· πάντα πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν γινέσθω.

controles.web: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.
controles.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
controles.livre: Então o que há, irmãos? Quando vos reunis, tem cada um de vós salmo, tem doutrina, tem língua estranha ,tem revelação, tem interpretação, tudo se faça para edificação.

versos.grego: εἴτε γλώσσῃ τις λαλεῖ, κατὰ δύο ἢ τὸ πλεῖστον τρεῖς, καὶ ἀνὰ μέρος, καὶ εἷς διερμηνευέτω·

controles.web: If any man speaks in another language, let it be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
controles.kjv: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
controles.livre: E se alguém falar em língua estranha , sejam dois, ou no máximo três, e alternando-se, e um que interprete.

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ ᾖ διερμηνευτής, σιγάτω ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ, ἑαυτῷ δὲ λαλείτω καὶ τῷ Θεῷ.

controles.web: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself, and to God.
controles.kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
controles.livre: Mas se não houver intérprete, cale-se na igreja, fale porém consigo mesmo, e com Deus.

versos.grego: προφῆται δὲ δύο ἢ τρεῖς λαλείτωσαν, καὶ οἱ ἄλλοι διακρινέτωσαν·

controles.web: Let the prophets speak, two or three, and let the others discern.
controles.kjv: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
controles.livre: E falem dois ou três profetas, e os outros julguem.

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ ἄλλῳ ἀποκαλυφθῇ καθημένῳ, ὁ πρῶτος σιγάτω.

controles.web: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.
controles.kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
controles.livre: Mas se a outro, que estiver sentada, for revelada alguma coisa , cale-se o primeiro.

versos.grego: δύνασθε γὰρ καθ’ ἕνα πάντες προφητεύειν, ἵνα πάντες μανθάνωσιν καὶ πάντες παρακαλῶνται.

controles.web: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be exhorted.
controles.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
controles.livre: Porque todos vós podeis profetizar, um após o outro, para que todos aprendam, e sejam todos fortalecidos.

versos.grego: καὶ πνεύματα προφητῶν προφήταις ὑποτάσσεται·

controles.web: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,
controles.kjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
controles.livre: E os espíritos dos profetas estão sujeitos aos profetas.

versos.grego: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ἀκαταστασίας ὁ Θεὸς ἀλλὰ εἰρήνης, Ὡς ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῶν ἁγίων,

controles.web: for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace.   As in all the assemblies of the saints,
controles.kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
controles.livre: Porque Deus não é de confusão, mas de paz, como em todas as igrejas dos santos.

versos.grego: αἱ γυναῖκες ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις σιγάτωσαν· οὐ γὰρ ἐπιτρέπεται αὐταῖς λαλεῖν, ἀλλὰ ὑποτασσέσθωσαν, καθὼς καὶ ὁ νόμος λέγει.

controles.web: let your wives keep silent in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to speak; but let them be in subjection, as the law also says.
controles.kjv: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
controles.livre: Vossas mulheres fiquem caladas nas igrejas; porque não lhes é permitido falar, mas que estejam sujeitas, como também a Lei o diz.

versos.grego: εἰ δέ τι μαθεῖν θέλουσιν, ἐν οἴκῳ τοὺς ἰδίους ἄνδρας ἐπερωτάτωσαν· αἰσχρὸν γάρ ἐστιν γυναικὶ λαλεῖν ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ.

controles.web: If they desire to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a woman to chatter in the assembly.
controles.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
controles.livre: E se quiserem aprender alguma coisa, perguntem a seus próprios maridos em casa; porque é impróprio as mulheres falarem na igreja.

versos.grego: Ἢ ἀφ’ ὑμῶν ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθεν, ἢ εἰς ὑμᾶς μόνους κατήντησεν;

controles.web: What? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?
controles.kjv: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
controles.livre: Por acaso a palavra de Deus saiu de vós? Ou ela somente chegou a vós?

versos.grego: Εἴ τις δοκεῖ προφήτης εἶναι ἢ πνευματικός, ἐπιγινωσκέτω ἃ γράφω ὑμῖν ὅτι Κυρίου ἐστὶν ἐντολή·

controles.web: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.
controles.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
controles.livre: Se alguém pensa ser profeta, ou espiritual, reconheça que as coisas que escrevo são mandamento do Senhor.

versos.grego: εἰ δέ τις ἀγνοεῖ, ἀγνοεῖται.

controles.web: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
controles.kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
controles.livre: Porém se alguém ignora, que ignore.

versos.grego: Ὥστε, ἀδελφοί μου, ζηλοῦτε τὸ προφητεύειν, καὶ τὸ λαλεῖν μὴ κωλύετε γλώσσαις·

controles.web: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.
controles.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
controles.livre: Portanto, irmãos, desejai com zelo profetizar, e não impeçais o falar línguas estranhas .

versos.grego: πάντα δὲ εὐσχημόνως καὶ κατὰ τάξιν γινέσθω.

controles.web: Let all things be done decently and in order.
controles.kjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.
controles.livre: Fazei tudo decentemente e com ordem.
